acceptance_status: Automated-inventory checkpoint; full functional/native/manual/performance/release parity remains open.
scope: Four Rust page-copy descriptors feed tools titles/intros/field and picker names/headings/action captions/history ranges/initial status; Rust also supplies clear-busy text. One additional transparent shared Metal underlay renders static and dynamic tools copy, excluding interactive controls and native history result rows.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

additional_performance_scenario_coverage.purpose: Execute all four opt-in performance scenarios as additional automated coverage, with their default 30 trials. Metal validation is enabled; these are not controlled CPU/GPU/drawable presentation comparisons.

contracts: Native control factories consume Rust page data while preserving callback IDs, existing stores, validation, IME and generation/profile/workspace guards. Context crossing the Rust page-copy ABI is only a workspace/profile display name, with no authority or native objects. Views retains the original native Label/control hierarchy and copy.

Tools titles, descriptions, headings, status, sleeping descriptions and empty/error history copy use childless static-text AX/layout adapters and Rust text primitives on one shared transparent Metal underlay. Interactive control rectangles and native history result buttons are holes; native result-row labels remain inside those controls.

The preference and tools canvases reuse the same renderer/recipes. Real Cocoa subview order keeps the underlay below foreground controls. Widget visibility/bounds, text/theme and synchronized native scrolling schedule updated clips and copy. Native Button/View/ScrollView/layout/focus/AX and font services remain adapters.

Standalone gfx::RenderText now supplies the same cursor-disabled, unelided, truncated-long-word line boundaries and minimum line height used by Label. The adapter caches measured lines for unchanged text/font/width; Rust places lines and Metal/CoreText paints them. No hidden native Label is used for measurement or drawing. Shared preference copy uses the same corrected adapter.

New shared backend oracles compare four page titles/descriptions plus Unicode multiline status at widths 80/160/320, verify page reconstruction and personal-profile display context. Dedicated Metal tests check absence of native Labels outside controls, actual scene text, underlay order, editor/selector/dismiss/native-result cutouts, scrolling, hide/reopen, theme and empty/error history copy.

CPU recipe fallback remains available when the shared canvas is absent. Native background painting and interactive/result controls are still present; this does not eliminate all CPU drawing or native views.
No new crate/library/dependency is introduced. gfx::RenderText was already part of Chromium; it is used as a standalone text service, not a Views control.

input.note: All 16 Views cases and 18 of 19 Metal cases passed. The native text oracle found 320px vs 300px height for two long intros at width 80. Replace approximate ElideRectangleText wrapping with the same standalone gfx::RenderText line-break service used by Label, without adding native Labels or changing the oracle.

initial_probe.resolution: Two long intros at width 80 measured 300px versus native 320px. Approximate ElideRectangleText wrapping was replaced with Label-compatible standalone RenderText line boundaries, preserving the native oracle. The status test also uses an explicit real line feed. Initial failures remain recorded.

initial_compile_issue: The RenderText cache member was initially inserted into a different class with an identically named lines_ member. It was moved to the intended static-copy adapter before the final build.
limits: Tools form/status decision coordination, some popup/empty-item/service wording and native result lists/row presentation remain. Other forms, browser-service panels, preference UI descriptions/data and remaining coordination, outer layout and native interaction/container ownership remain open.
Full native popup/manual IME/candidate-window, VoiceOver, complex bidi/RTL, typography/scale, pointer/trackpad, detach/reattach and GPU recovery acceptance remain open.
Optional scenarios provide execution coverage; no controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation speedup comparison or memory improvement is claimed.
Normal installed applications/profiles were untouched; no release bundle was packaged/signed. Final shipped-binary Apache-2.0/upstream license/notice acceptance remains open.
